purpose: Teach: 後援/図表/台数/ターミナル/コーディネーター/歴代/三井/近況

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯キャンペーン、地元企業の後援、ありがたく存じます。
lines.en: We're grateful for the local business sponsorship of this crime prevention campaign.
lines.style: Measured, formal opening. Even pace, composed authority. A slight pause after the opening phrase, as if consulting internal notes. Professional warmth without excess.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害状況の図表、警察様に共有しています。
lines.en: Yes. We've been sharing the damage reports and charts with the police department.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive tone. Measured cadence matching the officer's formality. Slight nod embedded in the voice — showing he's keeping pace with the protocol.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 巡回パトカーの台数、増強しております、当面。
lines.en: We're increasing patrol car numbers in the area for the time being.
lines.style: Factual, steady delivery. No inflection on the practical statement. A professional flatness that conveys routine competence and ongoing commitment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ターミナル駅周辺、警察と連携、強化中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're coordinating with the police to strengthen security around the terminal station.
lines.style: Attentive and earnest. Slight emphasis on 'coordinating' — showing he understands the partnership. Calm, no rushing. The cadence of someone checking off shared responsibilities.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯コーディネーター、自治体に、配置されました。
lines.en: A crime prevention coordinator has been assigned to the municipality.
lines.style: Formal announcement tone. Slight weight on 'assigned' — small pride in the institutional progress. Steady, clear, the voice of someone reporting positive development without overstating.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。歴代の警察署長、御社にも、ご縁がありました。
lines.en: Yes. The police chiefs over the years have had good connections with your company.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment beneath the formal surface. A half-smile in the voice — recognizing long-standing relationship and trust. Slightly softer than before, still professional.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 三井系企業、警察への協力、長年、いただいております。
lines.en: The Mitsui Group companies have been cooperating with us for a long time.
lines.style: Measured, appreciative tone. Slight emphasis on 'long time' — honoring continuity and reliability. Professional gratitude without effusiveness. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域防犯活動の近況、市民にも、お伝えします。
lines.en: Yes. We'll keep the community informed about the progress of these local crime prevention efforts.
lines.style: Affirming and concluding. Slight downward cadence on the final phrase — the closing of a productive meeting. Warm but formal, the voice of partnership confirmed.
